STEALING FROM SASSA

By: Nicky Troll | Paid

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
An exclusive investigtion exposes a unscrupulous broker that cheats the system to get Old Age SASSA Grants approved for people who should never qualify.

Unique Selling Point:
** A CARTE BLANCHE INVESTIGATION
** A NEW SPIN ON SASSA FRAUD THAT HASN'T BEEN REPORTED ON OR EXPOSED
** A CONFRONT
** AND A GOVERNMENT DEPARTMENT WORKING WITH US TO TAKE ON CORRUPTION

Summary:
After a Carte Blanche viewer sent in a tip off we started a three month long investigation to expose the dodgy dealings of Fatima Mayat – a helpful little old lady that helps people jippo the system to access SASSA grants they should never qualify for.

We go undercover to test her con, and bring her down in a confront with SASSA.


Further information:
We’ve heard of all the scams about buying SASSA cards to get a grant, but often those are just that – SCAMS – con-artists take your cash and disappear – no card is ever delivered.

BUT NOW we have people jippo-ing the system to get a legitimate grant paid out to them. These are people that qualify in terms of age for an old age pension from SASSA, but they DON’T qualify in terms of income restrictions – in other words, old people who have means that don’t need a government grant to survive. By paying the right officials and completely or rather omitting the right details, you get an old age government pension for a fee.

ENTER AUNTY FATIMA
Fatima offers you a one stop service. You pay between R600 and R800 for the initial consult and the application. She tells you what you need to bring for the submission, she does it and if you are successful she wants the first month’s payout. And then you get a healthy extra cash injection of R1890 every month – until you die.

But don’t be fooled Aunty Fatima is no good samaritan – once you start getting paid, she wants two months worth of payments.

UNDERCOVER
We’ve done two stings.

OPERATIVE 1
The first operative is someone that qualifies for the OAG – but we wanted to see if this broker could fast track the process. His application was successful in a few weeks, he received the first payment.

OPERATIVE 2
Then we sent in a second operative that while he meets the age requirement, he has financial means and should not qualify for a SASSA grant at all. The broker submitted his forms and his application was successful. We have kept the funds in a bank account and we will pay this money back to SASSA.

She knows full well what’s she’s doing is wrong.

WHY SOUTH AFRICANS SHOULD BE ANGRY
IT’s YOUR TAX MONEY!!! AND THEY ARE STEALING FROM THE MOST DESTITUTE IN SOCIETY, WHO ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR SUPPORTING ENTIRE FAMILIES ON THAT OLD AGE GRANT.

The OAG pays R1890 per month to more than three million people over the age of 60. When located within the broader economic and welfare system, specifically in the absence of social grants for working-age, able-bodied adults, old age grants are often the main source of income in poorer households. As such, the income is redistributed within multi-generational households, in which up to two thirds of children live. The reliance on the old age grant for many households in South Africa cannot be exaggerated and this is only set to increase during this pandemic.

INTERVIEWS
1. PRIVATE INVESTIGATOR – ARMAND TROLLIP (HE HAS MET WITH FATIMA AND DONE BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION INTO HER)
2. ELANA MOORE – PROFESSOR OF SOCIOLOGY AT UCT – HAS DONE EXTENSIVE RESEARCH ON SASSA GRANTS AND THE IMPACT
3. OUTA – TAX JUSTIVE – WHY WE SHOULD BE ANGRY
4. UNDERCOVER ELEMENT
5. TIP OFF DEVICE – WE FILM A LITTLE OLD LADY READING THE THE LEAD…. AS IF THEY ARE SENDING TO US - USE TO HELP WITH STORY TELLING
6. SASSA INTERVIEW AND BUST
7. CONFRONT




Extra Budget Items:
EXTRA COSTS
1. So far I’ve paid the initiation fees – R850 & R600 = R1450
2. Investigator fee R4000 (I needed old people to do the undercover and him to assist with the hidden cameras)

Script:


STEALING FROM SASSA

VO: In South Africa, bribery and corruption festers in almost all aspects of society across all industries.

LINK: The culprits are usually smooth conmen, dirty businessmen or politically connected cabals. But not this time around. Hmm. The culprits behind this investigation even took us by surprise - Granny's grandpa's cheating the system and essentially stealing taxes paid by you and me.

-VO: We’re talking SASSA grant fraud. Elderly, financially stable South Africans, exploiting cracks in the application process, to cash in on government social grants.

LINK: It all started with a tip off from a concerned Carte Blanche viewer, an elderly lady realized something was up when her bowling club friends started getting Sassa grants.

VO: The viewer wrote to us detailing her story and asked to remain anonymous. She was referred to a Johannesburg broker promising to get SASSA grants rubber stamped for people who should not normally qualify.

TIP OFF EVENT
The person who gave me her contacts, would never in the normal sense be applicable for [a] Sassa grant, as her and her husband's combined income and assets far exceed the Sassa limitations.
I tried phoning the Sassa Hotline as well as the Fraud Hotline without success // I am not sure if this is something that you would be interested in investigating.”

VO: We were very interested. This type of SASSA fraud has never been exposed before.

SASSA Old Age Grants are reserved for people over the age of 60, who are in financial need.

Associate Professor Elena Moore’s research revealed that these grants support entire families in many cases across South Africa.

ELENA: Currently, we have 5.4 million people over 60 of whom, // 3.7 million are receiving old age grant.//we must remember that this pension goes much further than going to individuals. It's heavily redistributed within the household.

VO: To qualify for the monthly R1890 grant, over 60 year old South Africans also need to confirm eligibility by doing a financial means test.

ELENA: There's a whole list of criteria in regards to annual income, assets, private pensions, etc., etc. There's quite a rigorous application process in which you have to prove // your income level and your assets level.

VO: But according to our source, this criteria is being overlooked for a fee.

LINK: Working through the info from tip off, We decided to test the waters and reach out to the so-called broker to establish for ourselves what the deal was and what it would take to jippo the system.

VO: This is Fatima Mayat. For a fee, she gets elderly people SASSA grants - eligible or not.

AF: I even lost count of how many people I’ve helped // i wouldn’t be doing it if i didnt know how

VO: To understand the process, we sent in an undercover operative that technically qualifies for a SASSA grant. He is 64 years old. His annual income is less than R86280 and he does not have any assets to his name.

Fatima needs an original ID, as well as a copy, proof of residence, a new bank account with no funds going into it, and then R800 to start the process.

As part of her service, she helps clients complete the SASSA application form step by step.

FATIMA: Even my SASSA forms, it’s the originals, its not copies, it’s not, it’s …
PI: So you get it from them, themselves
FATIMA: yes, yes
PI: You go fetch?
FATIMA: Yah, like now when I finish I must go back work to do the application.

VO: SASSA Head of Communications, Paseka Letsatsi, says that’s absolutely not how it works.

PASEKA: The individual has transgressed the laws in terms of opening a SASSA office, which is not a SASSA office, having documents of an organization in their private property.

VO: Private Investigator Armand Trollip accompanied the undercover operative. He got the sense that Fatima Mayat had intricate knowledge of SASSA processes - getting approvals within days.

ARMAND: She makes you feel and think that she's Sassa employee,//M15 but she's also making money out of it.

VO: Besides the initial consult fee, Fatima also demands a cut once the first grant payment comes through.

This amount varies from one applicant to the next. In the undercover operative’s case, he had to transfer R1758,06 to Fatima Mayat’s personal bank account.

MAC: But no skaam, she says people must pay directly into her bank account.
ARMAND: No Skaam. // She's been doing this for a while,

FATIMA: Between me and you, in order to get done, I have to tip a lot of people,

VO: While charging a fee is also illegal in terms of the SASSA Act, legalities don’t seem to phase Fatima.

We overheard a client asking if her husband could apply for a grant, even though he is employed.

FATIMA: He can apply. They don’t need to know he’s got a job. I won’t tell them.

VO: WE were curious to find out if Fatima can really get grants for financially stable people.

LINK: there was nothing illegal about what our first operative did because they do legitimately qualify for Grant and Aunty Fatima just helped to speed up the process. So we thought it'd push the envelope and get someone that doesn't qualify

VO: … REGISTERED.

We sent in one of our cameramen, he only meets the age requirement - his income and assets exceed the limit for a SASSA grant - making him ineligible.

Key to Fatima sidestepping the system, is advising clients to open a new bank account.

FATIMA: If there is anything in those certain accounts it can throw it off if there is enough for you to live on. THen we are in trouble.

VO: But there was no trouble. Our cameraman’s SASSA grant was approved on the day of his application. The grant money was deposited into his new bank account in less than a month.

PASEKA: What is painful, is the fact that if you steal a grant it means somebody else who's supposed to benefit will go to bed hungry.

VO: FAtima’s cut from the second sting was: R3213.

We alerted SASSA and with their backing, we paid this final fee to Fatima. This time round she shared a last little bit of advice on how to crook the system.

FATIMA: Going forward collect your money before the 18t of every month, transfer to another account, put it under your mattress, do whatever but do not give SASSA the impression that you don’t need it.

VO: Social Development grants are funded via Treasury, Wayne Duvenage from the Organisation Undoing Tax Abuse , or OUTA says the funds are in no way unlimited.

WAYNE: South Africa's broke at the moment, //M3//if you think of ten or twenties, fatimas around the country been doing this for a year or two years, who knows how long? And you add all those 2000 rands up a month, we could be talking a hundreds of millions of rands

LINK: Aunty Fatima’s time, it's up. She can't keep doing this.

MAC: Aunty Fatima – it’s Mac from CB, we'd like to talk to you, please.
AF: Sorry.
MAC: Don't close the door, ma'am. // Let's talk.

VO: FAtima, reluctantly let us in…

MAC: Is this a registered office? Are you a SASSA agent?
AF: Yes I am? //
MAC: so sassa knows you - this is officially what you do/ //Aunty Fatima, are you sure you're telling the truth?.
AF: I am. I am // I don't have anything to hide, my track record is a good one. Where I am actually helping people

VO: THe reality is, it’s not helping people when Government funds are exploited. Professor Moore explains it goes beyond just tax abuse.

ELENA: we need to take this matter seriously because // more importantly, // on an ideological level. It's disadvantaging // and morally wrong. //when you think about what an old age pension is supposed to do, particularly in South Africa, particularly given the history of the country.

VO: Despite being caught out, FAtima tried to justify her actions and even called in her daughter in an attempt to play the sympathy card.

AF: // Look, I don't have to be ashamed of what I did as a mother. First of all, I supported my mother. I supported my son and I supported my daughter
MAC: through the proceeds of crime.
AF: , I'm acknowledging this. I'm not saying that it's right.

VO: It would appear that SASSA’s application vetting processes are not foolproof, a weakness Letsatsi conceded to.

PASEKA: we need to make sure that we tighten up. But obviously, you know that where there's a human element, there will definitely people who tried to make sure that they beat their system // we think that the law must take its course and get to the bottom of this matter.

MAC: // who you working with at SASSA, who was giving you these documents?
AF: Let me get my lawyer. I think I'm not comfortable not answering these questions,

VO: We explained the severity of the allegations and that we had evidence.

MAC: // Do you know w hat you'r e doing? Is illegal?
AF: All right. I am aware of that fact,
MAC:. This is not a SASSA office….
AF: I can’t believe I trusted this guy….

VO: Running out of excuses, Fatima felt betrayed by our cameraman…..in spite of the fact that she helps people defraud state coffers.

MAC: This man is a cameraman. He earns thousands of rands, //You have made him qualify,
AF: why did he come to me?
MAC: Because we needed to show people that this thing you're doing is wrong.//
AF: tell me is necessary to show people,
MAC: What? I don't understand what you're saying to me.
AF: if I stop. M9 //All right between yourselves and myself. What is the way forward here? M8
MAC: You need to stop!!M8

VO: We demanded that she returned the SASSA money, our cameraman had just paid her.

MAC: Let’s give it, Please
AF: Ok, There's a start. //

VO: Fatima seemed to mistakenly think that giving the money back, would somehow make the story go away.

MAC: we’ll take it and make sure, yeah, you've got it on camera. This money going back to SASSA.

VO: While we returned the funds to SASSA, who knows how many people are still cashing in on illegitimately obtained grants.

WAYNE: I think they need to be held accountable, every single one of them. You don't deserve a cent if it's not due to you. // Society is going to come after you. We hope SASSA is going to come after you.

VO: SASSA’s Fraud MAnagement Team arrived with the police armed with a search warrant. We introduced Fatima to Mr. LEtsatsi.

MAC: So this this this is the Boss then. //This lady here says this is a SASSA registered office that she works for you. DO You know this lady??
PASEKA: No. I don’t, But I can confirm that this is not aSASSA office // Maybe she can confirm if she works for SASSA or not?
MAC: you work for SASSA?
AF: No I am not.//
MAC: you’re an agent - sassa has agents now?
PASEKA: second one, Sassa as an organisation does not have agents. // if you have to apply for a grants, you have to present yourself at the SASSA office
AF: Okay. Fair enough.
PASEKA: So the law has been broken
MAC: what do you have to say for yourself Aunty Fatima – you sat there next to me and said you were a SASSA agent. This is Sassa office.
AF: All right, right now. Let me contact my lawyer//
MAC: contact a lawyer. But these are SASSA agents and these are police. They have to do their work.
AF: Afternoon,
COPS: How are you?

VO: The police recovered official SASSA documents and cash in the search and seizure operation - a criminal case has been opened and the investigation is ongoing.

PASEKA: Committing a crime is committing a crime, / // unfortunately, they would have to face the music. M15

 
PROMO 1- 11 seconds
VO: An exclusive investigation exposes an unscrupulous broker that cheats the system to get Old Age SASSA Grants approved for elderly, financially stable people who should never qualify.



PROMO 2- 21 seconds
VO: We expose a dodgy broker that cheats the SASSA system for a fee – getting financially stable, elderly people government Old Age grants they should never qualify for.

PASEKA: the fact that if you steal a grant it means somebody else who's supposed to benefit will go to bed hungry. //

VO: Don’t miss this exclusive investigation.



PROMO 3 - 21 seconds
VO: We investigate an illegal SASSA office, pushing through government old age grants for a fee. The beneficiaries of this corruption are financially stable grannies and grandpas - who cheat the system to essentially steal taxpayer money.

WAYNE: I think they need to be held accountable, every single one of them. You don't deserve a cent if it's not due to you. //

metadata.Unique Selling Point: ** A CARTE BLANCHE INVESTIGATION ** A NEW SPIN ON SASSA FRAUD THAT HASN'T BEEN REPORTED ON OR EXPOSED ** A CONFRONT ** AND A GOVERNMENT DEPARTMENT WORKING WITH US TO TAKE ON CORRUPTION
metadata.Summary: After a Carte Blanche viewer sent in a tip off we started a three month long investigation to expose the dodgy dealings of Fatima Mayat – a helpful little old lady that helps people jippo the system to access SASSA grants they should never qualify for. We go undercover to test her con, and bring her down in a confront with SASSA.
metadata.Further information: We’ve heard of all the scams about buying SASSA cards to get a grant, but often those are just that – SCAMS – con-artists take your cash and disappear – no card is ever delivered. BUT NOW we have people jippo-ing the system to get a legitimate grant paid out to them. These are people that qualify in terms of age for an old age pension from SASSA, but they DON’T qualify in terms of income restrictions – in other words, old people who have means that don’t need a government grant to survive. By paying the right officials and completely or rather omitting the right details, you get an old age government pension for a fee. ENTER AUNTY FATIMA Fatima offers you a one stop service. You pay between R600 and R800 for the initial consult and the application. She tells you what you need to bring for the submission, she does it and if you are successful she wants the first month’s payout. And then you get a healthy extra cash injection of R1890 every month – until you die. But don’t be fooled Aunty Fatima is no good samaritan – once you start getting paid, she wants two months worth of payments. UNDERCOVER We’ve done two stings. OPERATIVE 1 The first operative is someone that qualifies for the OAG – but we wanted to see if this broker could fast track the process. His application was successful in a few weeks, he received the first payment. OPERATIVE 2 Then we sent in a second operative that while he meets the age requirement, he has financial means and should not qualify for a SASSA grant at all. The broker submitted his forms and his application was successful. We have kept the funds in a bank account and we will pay this money back to SASSA. She knows full well what’s she’s doing is wrong. WHY SOUTH AFRICANS SHOULD BE ANGRY IT’s YOUR TAX MONEY!!! AND THEY ARE STEALING FROM THE MOST DESTITUTE IN SOCIETY, WHO ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR SUPPORTING ENTIRE FAMILIES ON THAT OLD AGE GRANT. The OAG pays R1890 per month to more than three million people over the age of 60. When located within the broader economic and welfare system, specifically in the absence of social grants for working-age, able-bodied adults, old age grants are often the main source of income in poorer households. As such, the income is redistributed within multi-generational households, in which up to two thirds of children live. The reliance on the old age grant for many households in South Africa cannot be exaggerated and this is only set to increase during this pandemic. INTERVIEWS 1. PRIVATE INVESTIGATOR – ARMAND TROLLIP (HE HAS MET WITH FATIMA AND DONE BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION INTO HER) 2. ELANA MOORE – PROFESSOR OF SOCIOLOGY AT UCT – HAS DONE EXTENSIVE RESEARCH ON SASSA GRANTS AND THE IMPACT 3. OUTA – TAX JUSTIVE – WHY WE SHOULD BE ANGRY 4. UNDERCOVER ELEMENT 5. TIP OFF DEVICE – WE FILM A LITTLE OLD LADY READING THE THE LEAD…. AS IF THEY ARE SENDING TO US - USE TO HELP WITH STORY TELLING 6. SASSA INTERVIEW AND BUST 7. CONFRONT
